title: Audio Fingerprinting Discovered on Alibaba Websites While Debugging BLE Multipoint Disconnects
partialText: <img src="https://www.infoq.com/styles/static/images/logo/logo_bigger.jpg"/><p>A recent discovery revealed that AliExpress employs silent audio streams for device fingerprinting, leveraging the Web Audio API. This technique involves analyzing hardware-specific audio processing to distinguish user devices. Privacy-focused browsers have developed countermeasures, highlighting a security gap in current web standards regarding audio context initialization and user privacy.</p> <i>By Olimpiu Pop</i>

title: Astro Introduces Sätteri: a Rust-Powered Markdown and Mdx Processor with up to 60% Faster Builds
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/08/astro-satteri-rust/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1787817978309.jpg"/><p>Sätteri is a high-performance Markdown and MDX processor developed by the Astro team. Built in Rust, it enhances build speeds by up to 61% for Astro 7.0. Sätteri supports flexible JavaScript plugins and integrates various Markdown features natively. It maintains compatibility with the unified ecosystem while offering faster parsing and reduced dependencies.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: Nuxt 4.5: Experimental SSR Streaming, Vite 8 and an Rsbuild-Powered Rspack Builder
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/08/nuxt-4-5-streaming/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1787647116265.jpg"/><p>Nuxt has released version 4.5, featuring updates such as a switch to Vite 8, a new Rspack 2 builder, and experimental SSR streaming. This streaming enhances Time to First Byte by flushing the HTML shell instantly. The release also includes a stable error code system and new composables, alongside important upgrade instructions for developers moving from earlier versions.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: VoidZero Releases Vite+ Beta: a Unified Web Toolchain behind a Single Command
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/08/vite-plus-beta/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1787326368629.jpg"/><p>VoidZero has launched the beta of Vite+, a unified web development toolchain. It combines runtime, package management, and essential frontend tools under a single command. Vite+ supports various projects and is open source. The platform enhances workflow through features such as hot-reloading, format checking, and testing. The team emphasizes community feedback for future updates.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: Next.js 16.3: Instant Navigations, up to 90% Less Dev Memory and Faster Builds
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/08/vercel-next-js-16-3/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1787213210838.jpg"/><p>Vercel has released Next.js 16.3, featuring significant updates since version 16.0. Enhancements include reduced memory usage during development, accelerated build times, and improved type checking. Instant Navigations introduces faster, client-like responses while maintaining server-rendered architecture. Developers are advised to gradually adopt new features due to noted caveats.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: React Router v8: a Deliberately Boring Release with ESM-Only Builds and Default Middleware
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/08/react-route-v8/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1787041418977.jpg"/><p>React Router v8 was released on June 17, 2026, with minimal breaking changes and new baselines. Key updates include an ESM-only build and default middleware settings. React Router v6 and Remix v2 have reached End of Life. Developers should follow specific migration guidelines to update their applications, while some are considering alternatives like TanStack Router.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>
